# Third-party assets

The MVP uses Unity primitives, built-in fonts and locally generated materials only.
No third-party art, asset packs or downloaded audio are included.

`Assets/_Game/Content/Audio/Wind.wav` is original deterministic noise generated by
`DemoSceneBuilder.CreateWindClip`, using a seeded random source and a low-pass filter.

When adding external assets, record each asset here:

| Asset name | Source URL | License | Downloaded date | Files / size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
